title: Grant

abilities.description: What else the agent may do on these sources (ADR 0048): `watch` sets watches; `history` reads recorded data older than the last two hours (events, memory search, playback, clips, conversations). Live access (look, ask, listen, read environment) comes with the senses. Default both.

window.description: Live access (look, ask, listen) only inside the window; recorded data only from inside it. Either end may be open.

description: Scoped access for an agent: which sources, which senses, and optionally a time window. An agent key sees only what its grants allow; a request outside them fails with forbidden_sense (ADR 0024).
